knowledge.purpose: A lightweight rich-text (bold/italic/bullet-list) editor built on a contentEditable surface — basic-formatting authoring, not a full WYSIWYG document suite.
useCases: Long-form author fields such as an announcement body, a blog post or an idea description
antiPatterns: Not a replacement for a full document editor (tables, images, embeds) — keep it to short-to-medium prose
Do not use for plain single-line input — use form.input instead

jsonSchema.description: Field label, announced as the editor name.
FormData key: the sanitized HTML is submitted under it.
Initial HTML content. Sanitized before it is shown or submitted: only basic formatting tags survive, and links keep a safe href only.
